# Getting help

- **Learn how it works.** The [documentation site](https://andrew-farrey.github.io/onepagr/)
  has a getting-started guide, an end-to-end workflow, a theming guide, and a
  page on accessibility checks. In R, `vignette(package = "onepagr")` lists them.
- **Ask a question or report a bug.** Open an issue at
  <https://github.com/andrew-farrey/onepagr/issues>. A short example that
  reproduces the problem, built with `example_data()`, is the fastest way to get
  an answer. Add the output of `onepagr::check_quarto()` and `sessionInfo()`.
- **Report an accessibility problem in a PDF.** Use the accessibility template
  on the same page.
- **Report a security problem.** Do not use a public issue. See
  [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).

Please never post real, record-level, or sensitive data in an issue, in a
comment, or as an attachment.
